decks.notes: The main idea of this UW Control deck is to utilize counterspells, removal, and card advantage to control the game and protect your life total until you can establish a win condition, such as resolving Shark Typhoon or Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. The deck also includes lands that provide additional utility, such as Castle Ardenvale for creating tokens and Field of Ruin for dealing with problematic lands. By using a combination of control elements and powerful finishers, this deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver its opponents in order to secure victory.

The deck focuses on applying early pressure and disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Duress, Thoughtseize, and Fatal Push. It also utilizes aggressive creatures like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger, Bonecrusher Giant, and Bloodtithe Harvester to maintain board presence and deal consistent damage. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds consistency and versatility to the deck. The mana base is optimized for a smooth curve and efficient color fixing, allowing the deck to deploy threats quickly and efficiently.

The focus of this deck is to aggressively deal damage to the opponent using quick, efficient creatures and burn spells. It aims to put pressure on the opponent's life total early on while maintaining a steady stream of damage throughout the game. The deck also includes cards that can prevent the opponent from gaining life or stabilizing, ensuring that the aggressive strategy remains effective. By utilizing cards like Bonecrusher Giant, Chandra, and Monastery Swiftspear, the deck aims to close out the game quickly before the opponent can establish a strong defense.

The main focus of this Selesnya Aggro deck is to quickly build a board presence of flying angels and powerful creatures with lifelink. The deck uses cards like Bishop of Wings and Righteous Valkyrie to gain life and pump up its creatures, while also using Collected Company to search for key creatures. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and lifegain, creating a challenging board state for the opponent to deal with.

The main concept of this deck is to generate a large amount of life gain and create a strong board presence through a combination of creatures and spells. By utilizing cards like Amalia Benavides Aguirre, Wildgrowth Walker, and Return to the Ranks, the deck aims to gain life and establish a dominating board state. The inclusion of cards like Aetherflux Reservoir and Collected Company allows for explosive plays and the potential to quickly close out the game through a powerful combo finish. The deck focuses on creating a synergistic engine that can overwhelm opponents and secure victory.

This deck focuses on quickly casting spells to enable the aggressive return of Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard. By utilizing low-cost spells, card draw, and graveyard synergies, the deck aims to consistently bring back the Phoenix to deal damage to the opponent. The inclusion of disruptive cards like Picklock Prankster and Ledger Shredder helps to control the opponent's resources while maintaining pressure with the flying Phoenix. The deck seeks to overwhelm opponents with a combination of speed and resilience, utilizing the Phoenix's recursive ability to stay ahead in the game.

The deck revolves around utilizing the synergy between Amalia Benavides Aguirre and various creatures to create a powerful life-gain combo strategy. With cards like Collected Company, Chord of Calling, and Return to the Ranks, the deck aims to quickly assemble a board presence while gaining life through cards like Lunarch Veteran and Prosperous Innkeeper. This life gain enables the deck to stay resilient against aggressive strategies while also fueling powerful cards like Wildgrowth Walker. The inclusion of various utility creatures and lands adds versatility and flexibility to the deck's game plan.

The deck focuses on assembling a combo using Amalia Benavides Aguirre, Prosperous Innkeeper, and Wildgrowth Walker to generate mana and gain life. This allows the player to set up a strong board presence and efficiently cast spells like Collected Company and Return to the Ranks to further their advantage. Additionally, cards like Chord of Calling and Razorverge Thicket provide flexibility and consistency in executing the combo. The key strategy is to generate value from creatures entering the battlefield and maintain a solid life total to outlast opponents.

The deck focuses on aggressive plays with strong creatures and removal spells to quickly outpace the opponent. It utilizes powerful cards like Archfiend of the Dross, Bonecrusher Giant, and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to apply pressure and control the board. Additionally, the deck includes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to disrupt the opponent's plans. Overall, the deck aims to establish a dominant board presence while efficiently dealing with threats from the opponent to win the game quickly.

This deck focuses on using disruptive spells like Fatal Push, Thoughtseize, and Duress to control the opponent's board and hand. Liliana of the Veil and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse provide additional disruption while generating card advantage. Waste Not and Geier Reach Sanitarium help to generate more resources for the player. The deck also includes a few win conditions like The Meathook Massacre and Bitter Triumph to close out the game. Overall, Mono Black Control aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while slowly grinding out a victory.

This deck focuses on quickly getting Arclight Phoenixes onto the battlefield by casting multiple spells in a turn. It includes cards like Fiery Impulse, Opt, and Pieces of the Puzzle to fill your graveyard and bring back the Phoenixes. Use cards like Spell Pierce and Lightning Axe to protect your creatures and disrupt your opponent's game plan. Utilize Treasure Cruise and Temporal Trespass to refill your hand and keep the pressure on your opponent. This aggressive strategy aims to overwhelm your opponent and secure a quick victory.

The main focus of this deck is to swarm the board with small aggressive creatures that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck includes cards that protect and buff your creatures, as well as ways to generate additional creature tokens. The key strategy is to establish a wide board presence early on and use that advantage to deal damage quickly before the opponent can stabilize. The deck also includes cards to provide some protection against removal spells, ensuring that your creatures can continue to attack efficiently.

The deck focuses on quick and aggressive plays, using powerful creatures like Bonecrusher Giant, Graveyard Trespasser, and Kalitas, Traitor of Ghet to pressure the opponent. It also includes disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive strategy, with a mix of dual lands and utility lands to maximize consistency and flexibility. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of efficient threats and disruptive elements.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with aggressive creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Reckless Stormseeker. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of consistency to the deck. Utilizing mana acceleration from Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with efficient threats and assert dominance on the battlefield. The mixture of creatures, vehicles like Smuggler's Copter, and powerful spells like The Akroan War make this deck a formidable force in the Pioneer 1 vs 1 format.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with Arclight Phoenixes and casting multiple spells in a turn to bring them back for massive damage. It includes cards like Ledger Shredder and Treasure Cruise to help fill the graveyard, as well as cards like Consider and Opt to dig for more spells. Lightning Axe and Fiery Impulse serve as removal spells, while Picklock Prankster can disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to be aggressive and efficient, overwhelming the opponent with a flurry of spells and phoenixes.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the grave. The deck aims to be aggressive by playing low-cost spells like Otherworldly Gaze and Fiery Impulse while also generating card advantage with Treasure Cruise. Riverglide Pathway and Opt help with mana fixing and card selection. Ledger Shredder and Picklock Prankster offer graveyard interaction. The deck includes a mix of burn spells like Lightning Axe and Spikefield Hazard for removal and disruption. Hall of Storm Giants and Otawara, Soaring City provide additional win conditions.
